For a baby who **leaks at night**, the usual move is to buy **one size larger than their daytime diaper** in the Wiggle & Snug Snug-Fit Overnight Diapers—**as long as the larger size still seals well around the legs and waist**.

**Rule of thumb:**
- Daytime **Size 2** → try Overnight **Size 3**
- Daytime **Size 3** → try Overnight **Size 4**
- Daytime **Size 4** → try Overnight **Size 5**

Night leaks often mean the diaper is either too small/low-capacity or not fitting well. A slightly larger diaper can add absorbency for longer stretches, but if it leaves leg gaps or sags, it can leak more. A good fit should be snug at the waist, have no leg gaps, and not leave red marks. ([pampers.com](https://www.pampers.com/en-us/baby/diapering/article/when-to-size-up-diapers))

If you tell me your baby’s **weight** and **current daytime diaper size**, I can suggest the exact size to start with.
